summary.root_cause_text: Order worker thread stuck in a wait state (logged only at DEBUG 'worker entered wait state'), so the queue was not drained. The deeper cause is unknown.
recommended: Find out why the worker enters the wait state and doesn't wake up
Add an alert on a flat processed count with a growing queue_depth, because the heartbeat stays fresh while the worker is stuck
